channel.title: Divio incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Divio's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: DNS Service Disruption [resolved]
item.description: DNSimple has confirmed that all systems are operational and we can confirm from our side that domain resolution is working normally for all customers.

item.title: Cloudflare Global Network issues [resolved]
item.description: Service Impact Restored: We have confirmed that the intermittent issues affecting the Divio Control Panel and Media/Asset Delivery are restored.

item.title: Elevated error rate [resolved]
item.description: The fix has been successfully deployed across all regions and we can now report that all systems are back to normal.
